description: Source code for the Andes Technology ATCPIT100 counter driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing timer/counter functionalities including initialization, start, stop, alarm setting, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: get_current_tick
methods.description: Calculates the current timer tick based on reload and counter registers.

methods.name: atcpit100_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for the ATCPIT100 timer, managing alarm callbacks and clearing interrupt status.

methods.name: counter_atcpit100_init
methods.description: Initializes the timer device, configures channels, disables interrupts, and sets default counter parameters.

methods.name: atcpit100_start
methods.description: Starts the timer by enabling the channel.

methods.name: atcpit100_stop
methods.description: Stops the timer by disabling the channel and its interrupt.

methods.name: atcpit100_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current timer tick count.

methods.name: atcpit100_set_alarm
methods.description: Sets an alarm callback for a specific channel at a specified tick count.

methods.name: atcpit100_cancel_alarm
methods.description: Cancels an alarm on a specific channel.

methods.name: atcpit100_set_top_value
methods.description: Sets the top value (period) for the counter and optionally enables callback.

methods.name: atcpit100_get_pending_int
methods.description: Returns whether there are pending interrupts.

methods.name: atcpit100_get_top_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current top value of the counter.

methods.name: atcpit100_set_guard_period
methods.description: Sets the guard period for the counter.
